What a matching result means

The selected Arc RPC reports a successful included transaction. Its native USDC movement matches the expected recipient, amount and optional sender. The transaction receipt and block must agree.

Arc emits native USDC movement events at 18 decimals. ERC-20 USDC also emits a 6-decimal event for the same transfer. This tool uses the native movement stream to count each payment once. Mint and burn events are excluded from payment matching.

Fees use gasUsed × effectiveGasPrice at 18 decimals and belong to the transaction's gas payer. If multiple records use one transaction, its fee appears on each row but is counted only once in the total.

A reference is an off-chain label. This is a comparison of transfer details, not proof of unique invoice settlement, a tax receipt or an audit. Results depend on the selected public RPC. Deduplication applies within this batch; there is no shared settlement register. Historical testnet logs from before the native event change are unsupported.
